Name: OBJ_VERIFY_HELIOS
Title: Verify the AI Robot Fleet HELIOS's work
Description: Descend into the elevator shaft and inspect the autonomous construction work.

Name: OBJ_SURVIVE
Title: SURVIVE
Description: Recover from the elevator crash, escape the wreck, and find a stable path through the Luminous Rift.

Name: OBJ_DISCOVER_PLACE
Title: DISCOVER WHAT THIS PLACE IS
Description: Scan alien structures, hostile environments, and impossible materials until the cavern begins to make sense.

Name: OBJ_MAKE_MACHINE_ANSWER
Title: MAKE THE MACHINE ANSWER
Description: Learn how to operate ancient systems, route power, and communicate with the Abyssal Interface.

Name: OBJ_BUILD_WAY_OUT
Title: BUILD A WAY OUT
Description: Use discovered alien technology to fabricate tools, stabilize energy, and construct a return mechanism.

Name: OBJ_OPEN_RIFT
Title: OPEN THE RIFT
Description: Activate the constructed rift and return to the surface.
